integrity: Self-contained algebraic proof and standard-library numerical cross-check, whose finite sampling does not prove the theorem. Earliest public date belongs to the motivating rational-Gabor paper and not to this new result.
scientific_limitations: Exact optimal lower critical-density frame bound only for opposite-real-sign two-Cauchy kernels inside the strict protected interval; no upper bound, arbitrary complex ratio, noncritical density or independent validation claimed.
title: Exact protected-gap lower frame bound for signed two-Cauchy Gabor windows
